title: Meet your sensors
question: Start with physical instruments, not channel-name strings.
query:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/signal-atlas/>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>

SELECT ?sensor ?label ?property WHERE {
  ?sensor a sosa:Sensor ; rdfs:label ?label ; sosa:observes ?property .
} ORDER BY ?sensor
explanation: Six instruments. The same ?sensor binds facts together, just like a join key. a abbreviates rdf:type.
challenge: Add FILTER(?property = ex:Pressure) inside WHERE. You should get three pressure sensors.

title: Where was it installed?
question: Find installations rather than assigning one timeless location to a sensor.
explanation: Seven deployment records. P-101 moved from Manifold A to Manifold B on September 12.
challenge: Filter for ex:P-101, then compare the two half-open intervals [from, to).

title: Follow the hardware hierarchy
question: Walk one or more direct BOM links.
explanation: Four component/ancestor pairs. + means one or more hops; * would also include the starting component.
challenge: Replace + with * and explain the two extra rows. A path match is not a newly stored inferred triple.

title: Numbers with context
question: Observe the difference between window summaries and raw samples.
explanation: 24 summary observations, not 14,424 raw samples. AUX-401 has unbound metadata units, retained by OPTIONAL.
challenge: Remove OPTIONAL and its braces. Four rows disappear; inner joins can hide incomplete metadata.

title: Which results need review?
question: Expired evidence is not proof the hardware failed.
explanation: Three results use P-101 after the old certificate expired, with no covering approved replacement in this snapshot.
challenge: Use the what-if certificate experiment. A covering newer certificate must suppress a false expired-calibration alert.

title: Find missing evidence
question: Distinguish unknown calibration from a known expired certificate.
explanation: Four P-103 results lack any certificate in this snapshot. Do not describe them as proven uncalibrated.
challenge: Explain why “no matching triple” does not establish that a real-world calibration never happened.

title: Trace the evidence impact
question: Connect questionable evidence to draft reports and the relevant requirement.
explanation: Three draft evidence packages and the pressure-evidence requirement need review. The graph identifies a review scope, not a disposition.
challenge: Add ?report ex:status ?status and include ?status in SELECT. Where should human approval happen?

title: Ask who supplied a fact
question: Keep source assertions attributable even when IDs join across systems.
explanation: Facts about P-101 remain in the instrument-registry named graph. Provenance metadata for each graph is in the catalog graph.
challenge: Replace ex:P-101 with ex:CAL-P-101. Explain why a graph name is not itself proof that a source is correct.

title: Build a review subgraph
question: Derive a temporary set of review facts without changing the source dataset.
explanation: 15 derived triples for three observations. CONSTRUCT returns a graph; it does not INSERT it. No automatic OWL reasoning is running.
challenge: Inspect prov:wasDerivedFrom and the rule identifier. What extra approval would publication of this graph require?

title: Is a channel missing its unit?
question: Use a Boolean check, then inspect the separate shape-validation report.
explanation: True in the baseline: CH-AUX-401 lacks a declared unit. Raw sample units are still present; the adapter does not silently fix the registry.
challenge: Run the unit-repair experiment. Only the isolated copy is changed; source fixtures remain intact.

title: Select comparable evidence
question: Match property, unit, procedure, test phase and configuration before drilling into samples.
explanation: Five summaries: P-101 only at T-101, plus P-102 at every run. This is eligibility filtering, not proof of statistical comparability.
challenge: Open a result in Telemetry. SPARQL finds the context; parameterized SQL retrieves the sample series.

title: Inventory the assertion sources
question: Understand the dataset boundary before interpreting absence.
explanation: Nine nonempty named graphs: ontology, six source registries, telemetry summaries, and a provenance catalog.
challenge: Inspect the Sources page: file hash, snapshot time, version and source attribution. None proves the real world is complete.
